summary.text: Deb Haaland is the Democratic nominee for governor. An enrolled member of the Pueblo of Laguna, she served as U.S. Secretary of the Interior from 2021 to 2025 and as U.S. Representative for New Mexico's 1st District from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.A. in English from the University of New Mexico (1994) and a J.D. from the UNM School of Law (2006); started a salsa company as a single mother.
Chaired the Democratic Party of New Mexico (2015–2017) and was the party's 2014 nominee for lieutenant governor.
Elected to Congress in 2018 as one of the first two Native American women in the U.S. House; confirmed as Interior Secretary on March 15, 2021, by a vote of 51–40.
